dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the secrets that have been buried by time.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Where do I begin? You have to be more specific — that'd also help me recall.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Or perhaps there's a subject you have questions or are curious about.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Like the relationship between mass and energy, or the definition of certain cosmic laws in bounded sectors...
